olanzapina

dose_adult.indication: Transtorno bipolar I, episódios maníacos ou mistos (monoterapia)
dose_adult.note: A bula indica início com 10 ou 15 mg uma vez ao dia, ajustes de 5 mg em intervalos de pelo menos 24 horas; doses acima de 20 mg/dia não foram avaliadas.

cite.locator: seção 2.2 Bipolar I Disorder (Manic or Mixed Episodes)
cite.quote: Oral olanzapine should be administered on a once-a-day schedule without regard to meals, generally beginning with 10 mg or 15 mg.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Short-term (3-4 weeks) antimanic efficacy was demonstrated in a dose range of 5 mg/day to 20 mg/day in clinical trials. The safety of doses above 20 mg/day has not been evaluated in clinical trials"

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis
cite.quote: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death.
Hyperglycemia, in some cases extreme and associated with ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma or death, has been reported in patients treated with atypical antipsychotics including olanzapine.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Undesirable alterations in lipids have been observed with olanzapine use."

cite.quote: In an analysis of 13 placebo-controlled olanzapine monotherapy studies, olanzapine-treated patients gained an average of 2.6 kg (5.7 lb) compared to an average 0.3 kg (0.6 lb) weight loss in placebo-treated patients with a median exposure of 6 weeks; 22.2% of olanzapine-treated patients gained at least 7% of their baseline weight, compared to 3% of placebo-treated patients
cite.note: Mesma seção: "In long-term studies (at least 48 weeks), the mean weight gain was 5.6 kg (12.3 lb)"

cite.quote: If signs and symptoms of tardive dyskinesia appear in a patient on olanzapine, drug discontinuation should be considered.
Olanzapine may induce orthostatic hypotension associated with dizziness, tachycardia, bradycardia and, in some patients, syncope, especially during the initial dose-titration period
Caution is necessary in patients who receive treatment with other drugs having effects that can induce hypotension, bradycardia, respiratory or central nervous system depression
cite.note: Seção 7.2: "Given the primary CNS effects of olanzapine, caution should be used when olanzapine is taken in combination with other centrally acting drugs and alcohol."

cite.quote: In clinical trial and/or postmarketing experience, events of leukopenia/neutropenia have been reported temporally related to antipsychotic agents, including ZYPREXA. Agranulocytosis has also been reported.
Olanzapine should be used cautiously in patients with a history of seizures or with conditions that potentially lower the seizure threshold, e.g., Alzheimer's dementia.

cite.locator: seção 5.12 Potential for Cognitive and Motor Impairment
cite.quote: Somnolence was a commonly reported adverse reaction associated with olanzapine treatment, occurring at an incidence of 26% in olanzapine patients compared to 15% in placebo patients.

Zyprexa should be used with caution in patients with a current diagnosis or prior history of urinary retention, clinically significant prostatic hypertrophy, constipation, or a history of paralytic ileus or related conditions.
As with other drugs that antagonize dopamine D 2 receptors, olanzapine elevates prolactin levels, and the elevation persists during chronic administration.

cite.locator: seção 7.1 Potential for Other Drugs to Affect Olanzapine
cite.quote: Fluvoxamine, a CYP1A2 inhibitor, decreases the clearance of olanzapine. This results in a mean increase in olanzapine Cmax following fluvoxamine of 54% in female nonsmokers and 77% in male smokers. The mean increase in olanzapine AUC is 52% and 108%, respectively. Lower doses of olanzapine should be considered in patients receiving concomitant treatment with fluvoxamine.
cite.note: A bula também diz que a carbamazepina (indutor de CYP1A2) aumenta a depuração em ~50% e que fumantes têm depuração ~40% maior, mas não recomenda ajuste rotineiro de dose pelo tabagismo (seção 12.3).

cite.quote: Neonates exposed to antipsychotic drugs, including ZYPREXA, during the third trimester are at risk for extrapyramidal and/or withdrawal symptoms following delivery
There are reports of excess sedation, irritability, poor feeding and extrapyramidal symptoms (tremors and abnormal muscle movements) in infants exposed to olanzapine through breast milk
Eli Lilly and Company has received reports of fatality in association with overdose of olanzapine alone.
cite.note: Mesma seção: um óbito com ingestão possivelmente tão baixa quanto 450 mg; outro paciente sobreviveu a cerca de 2 g. A seção 5.2 manda prescrever a menor quantidade de comprimidos para reduzir o risco de superdosagem.

cite.quote: Fasting blood glucose testing and lipid profile at the beginning of, and periodically during, treatment is recommended
cite.note: Seção 5.5: "Patients receiving olanzapine should receive regular monitoring of weight"

common_effects.note: Mania ou episódio misto (bipolar I), monoterapia por 3 a 4 semanas. Astenia entra como cansaço. O ganho de peso tem alerta próprio (seção 5); com lítio ou valproato (Tabela 13) apareceu em 26%, contra 7% no placebo.
